studentItems.name: Limited-Edition Designer Sneakers
studentItems.tip: Footwear is a necessity, but paying top-tier brand premiums is discretionary spending.

studentItems.tip: Required to attend classes, library shifts, and internships on time.

studentItems.tip: Directly impacts grades. Pro-tip: look for used copies or library rentals first!

studentItems.name: Video Game Battle Pass / Skins
studentItems.tip: Great entertainment, but purely cosmetic and safe to skip when money is tight.

studentItems.name: Basic Nutritious Groceries (Oats, Eggs, Veggies)
